verdict.rationale: Deel's own pages say it runs compliant payroll for employees, contractors, and EOR workers in 150+ countries. Its MCP tools include an EOR-versus-entity hiring cost comparison, which shows both the employer-of-record and owned-entity paths are first-class. A community user also reports having about 75 people hired through Deel. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the EOR hiring and onboarding workflow and on owned-entity payroll setup (the evidence is marketing-level), and independent corroboration specifically of global payroll operation.
